decision_conditions: That notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning General Development Order 1988, no windows, doors or openings of any kind shall be inserted in the west flank elevation facing No. 55 Fox Lane of the development hereby approved unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: to safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.

This permission relates solely to the variation of Condition 6 of planning permission ref. TP/94/0319. Except as varied by this decision, all other conditions imposed on planning permission ref. TP/94/0319 shall continue to apply.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt, and to ensure the development remains in accordance with the approved scheme.

That the maximum number of residents to be accommodated with the premises shall not exceed 21.  Reason: (i) to ensure the use of the premises does not unduly prejudice the amenities of the adjoining and residential properties.  (ii) to ensure that the proposed development complies with the standards adopted by the Local Planning Authority and does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety along the neighbouring highway.

That the parking and turning facilities shown on the approved plan shall be constructed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority before any part of the development is occupied for the purposes hereby approved, or such longer period as may be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: to ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety along the neighbouring highway(s).

That the parking area(s) forming part of the development hereby approved shall be used solely for parking of private motor vehicles and shall not be used for any other purpose whatsoever.  Reason: (i) to ensure that the proposed development complies with the standards adopted by the Local Planning Authority and does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety along the neighbouring highway(s). (ii) to safeguard the visual amenity of the area.

That the premises shall be used solely for/as care home for the elderly, adults with physical disabilities, adults with learning disabilities, adults with mental health needs, or other vulnerable adults requiring personal care, and shall not be used for any other purpose within Class C2 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or for any other purpose whatsoever.Reason: to ensure the use of the premises does not prejudice; a) the enjoyment by neighbouring properties of their properties. b) the free flow of traffic and conditions of general safety along the neighbouring highway.

That the proposed building(s) shall be finished externally in materials to match the existing building to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: to secure a satisfactory appearance.

That the refuse storage containers shall be sited and enclosed in accordance with a detailed plan to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and such facilities shall be provided to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority before the building(s) is/are occupied and shall thereafter be retained solely for this purpose.  Reason: in the interest of visual amenity.

That the roof of the single storey rear extension(s) hereby approved shall not be used for any recreational purposes whatsoever and any access thereto shall be used for maintenance purposes only. Reason: to safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of the adjoining property(ies).

That, subject to the requirement of Condition 2-6 of this permission, the proposed development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and any plan or drawing submitted therewith, as amended by revised details shown on Drawing No. 94/11/02B received 23/05/94, submitted under cover of agents letter dated 20/05/94 before the development is used or occupied for the purposes hereby approved, unless the Local Planning Authority otherwise agrees in writing. Reason: to ensure that the proposed development will be carried out as approved and to avoid any detriment to amenity by reason of works remaining uncompleted.
